text.text: The Cisco Nexus 5696Q Switch offers scalability, high performance, investment protection, and flexibility for traditional, virtualized, and cloud environments. When fully populated, this four-rack-unit (4 RU) switch can support upto 32 ports of 100GE or 96 ports of 40GE/FCoE (384 ports of 10 GE/FCoE through breakout) or 160 ports of 8/4/2G Fiber Channel that can help prepare your network for the future.
